reserves.name: USDm (Mento Dollar) CDP collateral
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Mento Protocol and the shared Mento Reserve

reserveReview.rationale: Mento's pinned analytics configuration and current reserve API identify CHFm as a CDP whose sole direct collateral is the tracked USDm stablecoin. Mento Protocol and the shared Mento Reserve are the direct protocol and upstream reserve failure domains; USDm's underlying basket remains owned by cusd-celo and is not duplicated here.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento CHFm CDP collateral configuration and live reserve dashboard
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: CHFm's sole direct collateral category is USDm; USDm's own reserve composition is reviewed separately on cusd-celo.
